Emergency Communication

应急培训

Structured instruction and practice provided to crew members to ensure preparedness for handling emergencies such as fire, flooding, and evacuation on board.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 应急培训?

In this glossary, 应急培训 refers to: Structured instruction and practice provided to crew members to ensure preparedness for handling emergencies such as fire, flooding, and evacuation on board.

How is 应急培训 used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "所有新船员必须完成应急培训后才能上岗，包括灭火和救生艇操作。"

Why does 应急培训 matter in maritime?

应急培训 matters because it supports clear communication in Emergency Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses 应急培训?

应急培训 is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does 应急培训 belong to?

In this glossary, 应急培训 is grouped under Emergency Communication. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Structured instruction and practice provided to crew members to ensure preparedness for handling emergencies such as fire, flooding, and evacuation on board.

Operational example

All new crew must complete emergency training before being assigned to shipboard duties, including fire response and lifeboat operation.

Localized term

应急培训

Localized example
